About

Developer by passion, student by day

I'm a Flutter developer driven by a passion for creating cutting-edge mobile applications for Android and iOS. I focus on polished UI design, feature development and app performance — and I stay active in the Flutter community, constantly learning the latest tools and patterns.

Alongside my degree, I've completed internships at Arch Technologies and CodeAlpha, and shipped 10+ apps covering e-commerce, education, fitness, utilities and more — all open source on GitHub.

I work best in collaborative teams, write clean code following SOLID principles and MVVM, and I'm now looking for remote Flutter opportunities where I can contribute and keep growing.
